name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the summary captures the main topics and findings of the original research paper.
scale: Scale from 1 to 5, where 1 = Not relevant at all, 5 = Highly relevant.

name: Clarity
description: Assesses the clarity of the summary in conveying the information, including the use of appropriate terminology and ease of understanding.
scale: Scale from 1 to 5, where 1 = Very unclear, 5 = Very clear.

name: Completeness
description: Evaluates whether the summary includes all essential components of the original paper, such as background, methods, results, and conclusions.
scale: Scale from 1 to 5, where 1 = Very incomplete, 5 = Very complete.

name: Conciseness
description: Measures how succinctly the summary conveys the necessary information without unnecessary details or repetition.
scale: Scale from 1 to 5, where 1 = Very verbose, 5 = Very concise.

name: Technical Accuracy
description: Assesses the accuracy of the scientific content in the summary, including correct terminology and data representation.
scale: Scale from 1 to 5, where 1 = Many inaccuracies, 5 = No inaccuracies.

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates how engaging the summary is for the target audience, considering language style and presentation.
scale: Scale from 1 to 5, where 1 = Not engaging, 5 = Very engaging.
